args.title: Use config.publicUrl for BASE_URL in email templates
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL (falling back to localhost) when building BASE_URL, so password reset emails point to the configured domain rather than localhost.
